batting.name: RJ Quiney
batting.dismissal: c DP Nannes b A Nehra

batting.name: GC Smith
batting.dismissal: c AM Salvi b DP Nannes

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b AM Salvi

batting.name: J Botha
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b MF Maharoof

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b AM Salvi

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b MF Maharoof

batting.name: SK Warne
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b A Mishra

batting.name: A Singh
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b A Mishra

balls.text: and they get two to get to 150, Karthik is cramped up a bit by the drift, he still goes the sweep, which goes down the ground, but not fast enough, and they have enough time to get two
short, Karthik waits for it, and cuts it from front of the leg stump, for two to the left of sweeper cover
steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball, and hits it powerfully, to wide of long-on and gets two
steps out, looks for the slog sweep, gets a top edge, but no one in the circle on the on side, and it falls just short of Botha running in from deep midwicket
swept away, orthodox sweep, and he gets one to deep backward square
almost yorks Karthik outside leg, who is looking to make room, but he still gets single into the off side
Karthik looks for the scoop, is too early into the shot, but gets enough bat to chip it towards deep backward square for one. 25 off the over, he had given 14 in his previous three
this over is turning the game around, Munaf tries the slower ball, goes too short, and Karthik rocks back, and pulls it over midwicket, clean as they come
when it rains, it pours, as it is happening for Munaf, Karthik stepped away too early, Munaf saw it and went wide of off, and Karthik gets a thick edge wide of keeper
short again, and AB pulls it straight down the ground, just one
free hit, Munaf goes for the slower ball, it's short, AB waits, pulls in front of midwicket, and gets four to move to 400 runs this tournament
perfect hit, the first six of the match, no-ball, half-volley, straight over the bowler's head, six all the way
missed run-out, short, and pulled to long-on, AB goes for two, Botha goes for the keeper's end, where Ojha doesn't collect it cleanly even as Ab dives
on the stumps, length ball, and hit towards long-on
another superb slower ball, deceives AB, who is clearly early, and gets a top-edge over the keeper's head, he will take those four runs
slower ball, just outside off, Karthik recovers and plays a late cut, to Munaf at short third and gets a single
full, outside off, and played with an open face for one
dropped, slower ball, fools AB, it skies to between mid-on and long-on, Quiney makes superb ground, but after getting under it, couldn't hold on to it
slower ball tired, it's fulltoss, and hit down the ground, wide of Quiney at long-on, a fumble allows two
slower, outside off, short enough for Karthik to think of a late-cut, but this one hurries off after pitching and beats him
full on off, well played, to wide of long-off, and he will get two

this wicket should delay the late charge a bit, full, almost a yorker, around off, and DIlshan looks for the big sweep, misses completely, and leaves an open invitation from the stumps, which the ball accepts
hit powerfully, full ball on the stumps, but can't beat long-on
fulltoss, looks for the sweep, but gets the underside edge onto his boot, will get just one
he steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball, and plays it towards wide long-on
flat, on the pads, and helped away for a single to deep backward square leg
he does it this time, but since he has cut it from in front of his leg stump, eh can't beat short third man
Dilshan looks to beat short third man again, but can't get bat on the ball, it's too quick for it
full, on the pads, and turned away for one to deep backward square
late-cut from in front of the stumps, and he gets a single to short third
nice off break, at 94ks, beats a drive from Dilshan around the pads
short, flat trajectory, and punched away towards the sweeper on the off side
full, on the stumps, and hit towards long-on
full, on the stumps, and Dilshan goes for the slog sweep, but there is a deep midwicket in place
and AB gets to his 50, superb innings given the start Delhi got. He gets there with a punch down the ground for a single
angled into the pads, and turned away for one towards fine leg
flat, short, on the stumps, played to long-on off the back foot
gets this one to turn from off-stump line, but AB just dabs it for one to short third
slower, higher, and on the stumps, defended off the front foot
lovely placement, this is short and outside off, AB is waiting, goes in front of square, beats the sweeper-cover, perfect placement on a pitch that doesn't make for good square hitting
this is thrown up, Dilshan looks for the paddle, and is too early into it, but does pick a quick leg bye
no turn, just short of a length, and hit straight down the ground
tries a legbreak, but is way too short, it's a poor delivery, and AB rocks back to pull it through midwicket
slower this time, but wide outside off, and AB gets a single to sweeper-cover
flat, hurries AB into a defensive shot because it is on the stump
quicker still, a hint of turn, and gets a thick outside edge, for a single to short third man
flat again, not much turn, and hit to left of Warne at cover
flat, on the stumps, and defended
excellent shot, this was short, just a check-punch from AB, finds the gap between extra cover and the sweeper
full again, drivable though, and is hit to wide of cover, and they get a run
drift and dip again, forces AB to defend, it pitched leg stump and turned away
gets drift now, angling in towards pads, and then spinning away, Dilshan gets to the pitch of the ball and dabs it for a single to cover
well bowled, this one dipped on the batsman, spun away, took the outside edge, and ran away wide of slip, and they get three
slow, thrown up too, 71ks, turns away and gets a single to cover
flighted, outside off, this one turns away, and beats AB on the sweep
slightly short, Dilshan rocks back, and cuts, wide of short third, and gets a two
bowls a good spinner's length, this one turns in from outside off, and a single to long-on
that's bowled off a couple of steps, full, on the pads, and a single down to long-on
slower ball, turning in from outside off, and defended to cover
full, outside off, sliced away square of short third man and gets two
flat, fast offbreak, starts middle and tucks him on the leg side
goes for the flipper, 88ks, but this is too full, in front of the stumps, and is hit down the ground for one
another very slow legbreak from Warne, 77ks, and played with soft hands from just outside off, and gets a single
this one is short enough to be cut, and cut Dilshan does, towards sweeper-cover, where Amit fumbles again, but this time it doesn't cost them a run
sharp turner, pitched on leg, moved away, and he looks for the cut, and gets an underside edge
full, on the pads, and nurdled into the leg side for one
to rub the salt in, AB plays an exquisite shot through extra cover, off an overpitched delviery. Superb shot, classical
dropped, Dilshan looks for the cut again, and scoops it towards Amit Singh at short third man. It is dropped there, he doesn't have to move too much, but perhaps takes his eyes off early
flights it on the stumps again, and turned away towards deep backward square
late cut, in front of the stumps, against the turn, but just a single to short third
overpitched on the pads, and nudged towards fine leg
fulltoss on the off stump, hit off the back foot, towards sweeper
flat delivery on the pad, AB nudges it deftly towards the deep backward square leg, and runs two, capitalising on the lack of pace in that shot
this is short and wide too, and Warne is lucky that the batsman can't beat the sweeper-cover
a very slow legbreak, short again, so will be an easy single
flighted on the leg stump again, just short of a length, Dilshan stays on the back foot and gets a single to sweeper
flighted, turning, but just short of a length, and AB gets a single to sweeper-cover
starts off with a short one, turns away, but AB pulls it down the ground, wide of long-on, and gets a couple
back of a length again, and Dilshan looks for the late cut again, but this one hurries on after pitching and beats him
full on the stumps, and played towards midwicket
just short of a good length, spinning from outside off, Dilshan looks to run it down to third man, but misses
flighted, too full, and an easy single down to long-on
AB steps out, Botha drags it back, and forces him to defend
another offbreak, pitched up outside off, turning in, and played with an open face towards sweeper-cover
big offbreak, pitches middle, goes down the leg side
pitched up finally, wide outside off, and AB drives but can't beat the off-side ring, which is densely populated
slower ball this time, still short, AB recovers and pulls, but can't beat Yusuf at midwicket
when the cut don't work, pull. And pull does AB, short again, transfers the weight back, and pulls between mid-on and midwicket, a shot he plays especially well
short and wide again, cut to front of square, this one came slow too, so he could neither keep it down nor cut it square, but the ball bounced before it reached cover
again a short delivery, this time cut through the gully region, just a single
starts with a gift of a loosener, short and wide, gentle pace, and Dilshan crashes it over cover, powerfully hit
short and on the stumps, AB defends off the back foot
that's a clever shot, short and outside off, not short enough to be cut, he waits and open the faces of the bat, and gets a four between third man and slip - all along the ground
length ball, and just outside off, and Dilshan plays off the back foot, wide of mid-on
slower ball, short, 112ks, and defended off the back foot
back of a length, wide, and Dilshan punches off the back foot, through the covers
that bouncer got big on Dilshan, and audaciously Dilshan looks to push it over keeper's head, but the extra bounce beat him
Dilshan scoops again, and connects this time. There is no fine leg, the deep backwards square leg has to run and do the cutting
short and wide again, slapped away again, but can't beat Jadeja at point. It must have stung, it's cold and was hit hard
Dilshan looks for the scoop this time, but this is well outside off, and he misses it completely
Smith is alert at point, this one was short and wide again, didn't stop, so made for a good cut, but Smith dived to his right and prevented any runs
and almost another one, this was short and wide, AB shaped for the cut, but this one stopped on it, and fell just short of point
length ball, on the middle stump, defended off the back foot
length ball, on off stump, defended off the front foot. Superb over

Sehwag almost walked, that's two in the same over for Munaf. This is short too, Sehwag jumps, looking to play it into the on side, but this one stays low, and catches him right in front. Sehwag knew all along he was gone. Munaf is carrying on from his last over against Mumbai
looks to tuck him up again, but this one doesn't rise enough, and is helped away towards square leg
short again, but angling into the pads, and he gets two runs towards fine leg
stays back of a length, pushes AB to the back foot, and he defends

what a ripper by Munaf, this is an unbelievable catch, back of a length, Gambhir hits it back towards his good friend Munaf. This is going straight over the stumps at the non-striker's end, but Munaf stretches his right hand and intercepts perfectly. Munaf's fielding has been a revelation during this IPL
tucks him up on the pads, Gambhir gets tall and bunts it down for a single
keeper comes up, but Gambhir stays in the crease, and hits him straight down the ground, full face of the bat, straighter of mid-off
stays back of a length, Gambhir stays in the crease too, and defends towards point
Gambhir walks down the track, Amit pulls the length back, and he dabs it down towards fine leg for two
back of a length, outside off, Sehwag looks midwicket, gets the bottom edge towards mid-on, gets a single still
on a length, and on target, just around off stump, and defended back towards the bowler
back to length, moves away a touch, and defended off the back foot
and Munaf bowls a short one again, Sehwag top-edges, Munaf catches it, celebrates, but has forgotten it was a free hit
slower bouncer, beats Sehwag on the pull, but it is the second bouncer of the over
no-ball, goes for the bouncer, and oversteps
back of a length, just outside off, extra bounce, and Sehwag withdraws late
back of a length, again going across the left-hander, and helped away to the third man
length ball, angling across from off stump, and left alone again, it dies on the way to the keeper
back of a length, angled across, left alone
wicked Nannes ends with a bouncer, Trivedi sways out of the way without incident. Easy win for Delhi
that's the end of Munaf's fun, bouncer, backs away, looking to sway out, but the ball finds the bat and rolls along to third man
oh almost another boundary, short of a length, on the off stump, Munaf makes room, and slashes, looking to go over pint, but misses
tries a yorker, but it's a bit short, and Munaf makes room, and drives through extra. Three boundaries in a row for Munaf. Has he ever done that before?
and Munaf gets four more, full and straight, same shot, Munaf makes room again, and it goes over point again. Munaf is having good fun
shot Munaf, round the wicket, short, and Munaf makes room and slashes it over point
slower ball, almighty slog from Trivedi, and needless to say he misses
back of a length again, Trivedi makes room, and is beaten by the extra bounce as he looks to run it down to third man
full, outside off, and Munaf crashes it through the off side, straight to Gambhir again, at sweeper-cover
makes room, and chips this over the infield on the off side, falls short of sweeper-cover
back of a length, Trivedi makes room, and hits to right of sweeper-cover for two
on the stumps, back of a length, chopped towards point
and he has something to talk about, gets out of harm's way again, and looks to play with an open face, gets an inside edge to fine leg for four
shot Munaf, not bad at all for a No. 11, makes room, and guides it between gully and backward point. Good harmless fun
another short one, Munaf gets out of the harm's way, and then looks to run it down, but misses
full, on the stumps, and Trivedi makes room to get a single to sweeper-cover
another bouncer, Munaf makes room and looks to upper-cut, and gets a single to third man
fuller, on the stumps, and a single to third man
bouncer, too high, and Trivedi looks to upper-cut but misses
and third time lucky for Mishra, Warne steps out again, Mishra plays ball, flights it, and Warne looks to go straight, misses, and doesn't even make an attempt to go back in
that's too little, too late, steps out again, gets to the pitch this time, and clears midwicket easily, this is a big ground
Warne steps out, too early, Mishra shortens the length, and forces a defensive shot
another catch off a free hit, Sid swings royally, gets the back of the bat, and it spoons to short third
no-ball, tries a googly, over-steps, pitches middle and beats Trivedi, but it was going down anyway

that's a tame stumping, big legbreak, angles in from wide of the stumps, spins across Singh, who has just about dragged him foot out, but makes no attempt to go back in, Karthik is alert to it and whips the bails off fast

Mishra continues, and Mishra cleans Raut up, he steps out too early, Mishra bowls a regular legbreak, the head is nowhere, swings wildly at it, and misses it completely. The ball doesn't spin much, and takes the off stump
Raut faces, though, steps out, and is cramped with a short delivery that follows, gets a single down to third man

Maharoof gets his revenge the next ball, bowls short, Botha looks to go over midwicket, and gets a top edge, which flies straight to Sehwag at midwicket. Rajasthan move closer to the end, or so it seems
shot, smart, gets on a knee, takes the fulltoss, and scoops it square of short fine leg, just in time to bring the asking rate down
steps out again, makes room, Maharoof follows him, and he ends up with no room, and manages an inside edge for one
steps out, sees it, and a smart bouncer is the predicted result, looks for the upper cut but misses
fullish, on the pads, and played down to long-on
fulltoss, that's the ball, but he doesn't get all on it, and it flies towards midwicket boundary, where Manhas recovers well from a fumble to save the boundary
flat, on the stumps, and played back to the bowler
bowling Amit, perfect legbreak, thrown up, enticing him out, pitching off, and then turning away and beating the defensive
flighted on the pads, no turn, and he dabs it to wide of long-on and runs two
full, outside off, hit with a closed face towards long-on
flat delivery outside off, and dropped into the off side for one
just back of a length, on the stumps, no room, and he drops it towards cover and runs through for one
good bouncer, sees him front-footish, and slips in the bouncer, which is left alone outside off stump
Raut drives on the up right away, length ball, outside off, and finds the gap to the right of cover
slower ball again, wide outside off, Botha waits for it and cuts it to sweeper-cover

that's the biggie, slower ball, on the pads, Yusuf's eyes light up, looks to loft over the leg side, gets the back of the bat, and the ball swirls towards short third, three men converge, Karthik, running back, calls for it and takes it safely
fulltoss, pretty high, just about waist high, touch and go on the call, and played down towards deep backward square
pitches it up this time, outside off, drivable length, but Botha drives it straight towards long-off, so just a single
back of a length again, just outside off, not enough room, so all Yusuf can do is guide it wide of cover
length ball, a touch slower, within the stumps, and defended off the front foot
short again, on the off-stump line, played with an open face, but no run
back of a length again, tucks Yusuf up, who is on the front foot too early

and the change has worked, first ball gets a wicket, extra bounce there, back of a length, on the leg, angling across, Jadeja looks to run it down to third man, and gets the outside edge via the extra bounce
just short of a length, and hit to wide of long-on, the call for two is early, and they come through easily
lazy cricket from Sehwag, hit straight to him at cover, slow in bending and and misfields, which gives him one
a well-bowled topspinner, he is late into the shot, but the inside goes towards short fine and they get a single
full on the pads, and turned away for a single
short, across the left-hander, and played to the right of point, and a fumble gets them two
straighter one, and Botha gets the inside half of the bat, but a single nonetheless
full on the middle stump, cleared the front leg and swept it powerfully for another boundary, good over this for Rajasthan
on middle and leg, Jadeja pats it back down the pitch
pushed back to the bowler, who misfields slightly to allow a single
tossed up by Dilshan. Jadeja responded with the forward press, but the ball hits his pad before getting an inside edge and rolling to the leg side
short of a length ball, waited on the backfoot, and carved it behind backward point, superb placement there, and that's a boundary
first ball after the break is dispatched towards deep midwicket by Botha, off the backfoot and getting the front leg out of the way
short and wide, and cut late, beats point and the sweeper-cover has to run in fast to save the boundary
short, but turns sharply from outside leg, and pulled wide of long-on
stays short still, and pulled into the on side, but the boundary there is well populated
he bowls a slow, short delivery, doesn't turn either, and Jadeja looks to pull it and misses completely
no-ball, that's criminal for the spinner, on the pads, and scooped towards fine leg
short, angling across, cut away towards sweeper-cover
starts off with a flat delivery, beats him on the sweep, but the ball falls safely off the glove
length ball, angling across, punched with an open face, and beats point, but the third man gets around. Good over for Rajasthan, 13 off
a pull off the front foot, Salvi bounces again, and Jadeja seems to be expecting it, pulls over midwicket, second boundary of the over
this one holds its line, from a length and just outside off, and played from the outside half of his bat, towards third man
these are fortunate runs, nipped back in from outside off, got the inside edge, onto the back pad, and then beats the keeper
Salvi goes back to bowling length, and Botha punches off the back foot, and straight to cover
not pretty but Botha gets four more, this was another short delivery, Botha had to stand tall, and pull down on this one, which he did and also beat midwicket
length ball, angling in to the pads, and turned away towards fine leg
and Botha steps down and finally gets a boundary, this was short, and angling, and he lofts it between deep backward square and midwicket
short on the pads, and chipped away towards deep backward square, it's well placed and they will get three
just back of a length, punched from outside off towards mid-off, and rushes through. Sehwag goes for the stumps, and gets Botha in the hand. This will sting in the cold
length ball, starts leg stump, angles away, and played with an open face of the bat towards third man
length ball, angling in, good bounced too, tucked away into the leg side
fuller delivery, wide outside off, and Jadeja tries to cross-bat it and misses completely
walks down, turns it into a length ball, bludgeons it down the ground, but Sehwag makes a diving save at mid-on
wide, angled across too, but it's not short enough to be cut as Jadeja tries - and misses
wide, goes for the bouncer, but it's down the leg side
length ball, on the leg stump, played down to mid-on
this was on the cards, Ojha was looking to get outside the line way too often, this is a length ball, he makes room again, looks to go over extra, but doesn't get enough power. Simple catch too
good bowling, this pitch has definitely spiced up, back of a length, holds its line after pitching off, and the bounce beats him
another nippy delivery, shapes in from outside off, towards the pads, and he plays it down to wide of mid-on
beats Ojha with the extra bounce, short, shaped in a bit, Ojha looked to run it down, but is beaten for height
good comeback, nipped back in, from back of a length outside off, cramps the batsman
slower ball, Ojha picks it up, stays back, and lofts it over Maharoof's head. Top shot. He spotted it well, and went straight
short and wide, Ojha looks for the cut, but this one keeps low, and bounces twice on the way to Karthik
back of a length, Ojha punches crisply again, but can't beat point
back of a length, on off stump, punched away to left of point, but the third man is square so it will be only one
length ball, just outside off, and defended off the back foot and they scamper through for one
Botha goes for as big hit now, just back of a length, goes for the big waft, doesn't connect properly, but has enough on it to take it clear of mid-off
misses out this time, this one was a length ball, on the pads, but Ojha is beaten by the angle, gets a leg-bye though
short, on the stumps, punched with an open face, but can't beat point
starts with a loosener, overpitched outside off, driven but can't beat Gambhir at cover
length ball, starts off, angles across, and left alone
looks for the pull, but it's not short enough, and is beaten again
he is troubling Botha with the pace, beats him with a back-of-a-length delivery again, just for the pace, hits his back thigh, and goes as far as the second slip
big bouncer again, this took off from just back of a length, but this is down the leg side
stays with the short length, rises rib-high again, but wide of off stump, and he dabs it down to third-man
extra bounce again, pitches leg, gets into his ribs, and beats a defensive, but Botha will get a leg-bye
tries the short one again, but way down the leg side
good, fast bouncer, 140ks, Botha ducks, Karthik takes this over his head
a touch slower and fuller, on the pads, Ojha turns it into the on side, but can't beat square leg
length ball, outside off, and defended with an open face towards cover
short, just outside off, and hit straight towards AB at point
shaping in towards the right-hander, full it was, so he can nudge it to deep backward square for one

and another Rajasthan opener has picked out a boundary fielder, and there are only two allowed in the Powerplays. This is short and into the pads, he pulls it straight to Nannes at deep fine leg, who seems to have come in too far, but catches it well over his head
beats him with the shape this time, just outside off, holds its line as opposed to heading with the angle, and beats a Quiney defensive
length ball, outside off, and he gets a single to wide of point

Smith goes out on the upper cut, this was short and wide, and he cut over point, the thirdman is square. It's straight down Salvi's throat, who fumbles, but recovers well on the second attempt behind him
just back of a length, fast, 138ks, and wide outside off, Smith lets it go
short, tucks him up, 137ks, beats him for the pace again
that's sharper than the 134ks the gun shows, angling into the pads, and beats him easily with the pace
short and wide, 141ks, stands tall, on the back foot, and punches it through extra cover, superb shot
good line and length, just outside off, short of driving length, swinging a touch, Smith defends off the front foot
angles too far down the leg side
off the mark, length ball outside off, waits on the back foot and plays with an open face towards third man
fuller, on the stumps, leans, and defends it with an open face
length ball, just outside off, and shaping away, left alone again
a bit of a swing, which saves this short one from getting hit, Quiney ends up missing it
back of a length, moves away from outside off, and he lets it go
